note: Hold-ups on the road and the rail (src/systems/holdups.gd) and the posses that come after (src/systems/hunters.gd): Ruth's demands, the crew, passengers, bounty hunters and county deputies. Original writing.

lines.speaker: ruth
lines.line: Rein in! Hands where the sun can find them.

lines.speaker: ruth
lines.line: Shut her down, engineer. Nobody needs to be brave today.

lines.speaker: ruth
lines.line: The box. Gently. It's done nothing to you.

lines.speaker: ruth
lines.line: Open the safe, son, and you'll have a story for your grandchildren.

lines.speaker: stage_driver
lines.line: Easy, easy! The line don't pay me near enough to argue.

lines.speaker: shotgun_guard
lines.line: Not on my run, you don't!

lines.speaker: shotgun_guard
lines.line: All right. All right. I've a wife in Coldwater.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.line: Throttle's shut. She's yours till somebody says otherwise, God help us.

lines.speaker: messenger
lines.line: The express company pays me to say no, and I mean to earn it!

lines.speaker: messenger
lines.line: Combination's in my head and my head's in your sights. Here.

lines.speaker: hunter_boss
lines.line: Ruth Caddell! There's paper on you, and we'd sooner bring it in breathing.

lines.speaker: hunter_boss
lines.line: Throw the loop! Keep her down!

lines.speaker: hunter_boss
lines.line: Dead weighs the same across a saddle. Open up!

lines.speaker: hunter_boss
lines.line: That's the end of the ride. The county can have the rest of you.

lines.speaker: hunter_boss
lines.line: Wire says your debt's settled. No profit in you now. Good day to you.

lines.speaker: deputy
lines.line: In the name of the county, throw down that iron!
